AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Provides tools for restaurant ordering, including finding low-price items and placing orders. Operational Patterns: - Use 'findLowestPriceItem' to identify the cheapest item. - Then call 'orderItemByName' with that item name to complete order placement. - Alternatively, use 'orderLowestPriceItem' to find and order in one step. Constraints: - Item name for 'orderItemByName' must map to exactly one menu item. - Category filters are optional for lowest-price queries.
